authoring_shape.optional_full_proof_field: manual_role_views: nonempty bounded array of exact photo-manual-semantic-role-view/v1 declarations; absent means do not compile/add any view fields.
authoring_shape.optional_role_field: roles[role_id].view_refs: nonempty unique IDs of these same-source views. fact_refs remain the same original canonical fact IDs; guard_refs remain separately governed.
authoring_shape.view_fields: Exact existing helper VIEW_FIELDS; no source-specific shortcut, new target/value/property/dimension, supplied expected binding or eligibility boolean.
native_crosschecks: Every view ID referenced by its actual role, role/spec hash, declared role RID and canonical fact_refs. Reject orphan/foreign/duplicate references; every referenced view canonical fact is also an ordinary role fact_ref on that same actual RID.
Each out-of-prefix (dimension or property) canonical fact support needs its own explicit validated selected view. Existing dimension+property prefix ordinary support remains preferred and unchanged.
A view on another fact/field/RID/role cannot excuse the failing fact. Whole_record and positive_alternative RID coverage remain unchanged.
Mode checks precede direct-or-view choice. Context cannot support direct; actual-valued P/PR remain P/PR; preservation reference sentinel cannot become a view trait.
Views reference only ordinary semantic direct canonical facts and complete requires closure. semantic_reference/nonsemantic/guard-only source fragments never become a new scalar view.
All canonical E values/types/operations/receivers and original target/receiver positions remain unchanged. No facet property or permission projection is authored by the engine.
authoring_shape.no_field_hash_rule: Leave native_contract_sha256 implementation unchanged: it already hashes every proof field except review plus exact review bindings. Optional manual_role_views and role.view_refs are included only when explicitly authored. Old absent-field proofs, signatures, compact JSON and fit/receipt output remain byte-identical.

authority_and_compact_flow.rule: Run all original provenance/signature/exact positive quotes/source units/actual RIDs/owner maps/effects/source guards/required and optional declaration closure/profile/reference checks first. Only then construct helper context from these actual values. Do not accept caller-prepared context or source_qualified flag.

Use actual source CID/meaning, deterministic full actual RID inventory, actual catalog, full canonical facts and ordinary source units. positive_fields come exclusively from primary_paths plus positive_string for each actual RID. closure_snapshot is exact owner_maps/effect_sets/guard_sets/dependencies/profile_contracts/reference_sha256 from validated proof. Context is not evidence inferred from tags.

authority_and_compact_flow.path: same common native direct-or-manual support helper in validate and qualification
authority_and_compact_flow.rule: For every canonical role fact retain old mode/RID checks; ordinary prefix match or exact explicitly referenced view support. Every source obligation still validates even if it has no role. Manual semantic entailment remains the reviewer/root duty.

When optional views exist, replace full manual_role_views with compiler-generated manual_role_view_bindings using compact_views(validated, authoritative_contract_sha256=locally recomputed actual full-context digest). Preserve role view_refs and qualification_sha256=hash(entire full proof). Include only this opt-in field in existing compact seal. Never expose an external expected_binding argument as a compact factory authority.

For opted-in proofs obtain actual full record from source_data.candidates[CID]. LazyRuntimeData uses existing SearchReader.record hash-checked pinned payload; never use compact metadata/public pack authored_record as the authority source. Full-native-validate this source and derive expected receipt anew. Compare current candidate CID/meaning/catalog/whole proof qualification hash against it before selected_support. Outer source/proof pins are mandatory because pure source_contract digest alone does not include every native role/review field.

The receipt under test and independently built expected receipt must exactly agree. Without authoritative source data, missing/stale/forged receipt returns structured review_required/invalid and never eligible. No result class, own hash, recomputed native/compact digest, provenance string or caller-provided expected binding grants authority.

Only this existing fit call chain needs explicit source_data pass-through. Use new optional matched view metadata solely as support explanation and return original canonical matched_properties. Public pool/proposal copies are informational and remain exact-audited; no pack reissue or candidate-driven core enrichment.

authority_and_compact_flow.rule: Rebuild support from pinned source_data at audit time, compare proposal/source payload exactly, retain complete canonical E/P/PR/guards/dependencies/profile requirements and all owners/receivers/locks. Fresh runtime repeats same source/proof/pack/composed selection checks; role view never changes owner resolution receipt or outer preflight schema.

Existing reader block cache may reuse verified bytes; no new cross-request capability/cache is needed. Do not reintroduce subset cache authority or add a second member expansion. If later performance needs memoization, pin complete full source/proof/catalog/closure identity and separately review its authority boundary.

Pass exact source_data along the single fit path; no public expected_binding parameter. Lazy record hydration is actual source-checked; lookup stage returns original fact properties/modes and optional support metadata only on explicit opt-in.

Execute existing actual synthetic layout/lazy pack/proposal replay/full compose/fresh runtime workflow, required+selected optional/member/profile cases. Assert immutable pack and B1 once per full audit. Request additional production path only on preserved actual drop failure.
